title: lei-commons snapshot edition
description: One day's edition of the lei-commons directory: its signed manifest and root, whether it is a full snapshot or only the day's changes, the full snapshot it builds on, the sealed decision log it carries, and where to fetch it whole.

anchor.description: The full snapshot this day's state starts from.

base.description: The previous day, whose state this day's changes apply to.

signature_url.description: The manifest's Sigstore bundle, once the release has signed it.

recipe_url.description: Every file needed to assemble this day, in order, with SHA-256s.

relationship_parts.description: On full days: the relationship files (url, sha256, bytes, records, root).

decision_log.description: The decision log's seal carried by this manifest (days sealed and chain head).
